mostWorthwhile.text: Building aerobic ATP renewal was most worthwhile: the planned illustration connected fuel oxidation, oxygen, the hydrogen-ion gradient and ATP synthase without treating fuel and oxygen as interchangeable.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to pair ATP renewal directly with the pump was confusing: the pump needed installation first, although its ATP-binding site made the attempted connection plausible.

surprise.text: The incompatible pump attempt automatically produced new cell proteins instead. The protein route was compatible, but I had not chosen it as the action to perform.

arbitrary.text: The pump's membrane-installation requirement had a clear physical purpose, but the automatic switch to protein production felt less directly connected to my attempted action.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the constructions linked familiar cell biology to membrane transport and energy use, and I would be curious to see how those connections extend to tissues and organs.
